title: 十二支のどうぶつ ゆるかわ
subject_en: the 12 Chinese-zodiac animals, each one a distinct original kawaii mascot, each standing and wearing a small red-and-gold haori jacket, bowing slightly in a New Year greeting; keep one consistent face style across all 12
lead: 子・丑・寅・卯・辰・巳・午・未・申・酉・戌・亥。十二支のどうぶつ12ひきを、おそろいの羽織すがたでそろえました。毎年の年賀状に使えます。
